target_role: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
briefing_text: Anthropic is hiring a Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships to lead Partner Solutions Architects supporting Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners including AWS, GCP, and Azure, and strategic technology partners. The role emphasizes partner-led pre-sales processes, GSI and cloud partner enablement, joint GenAI solution development, reference architectures, technical deal support, product feedback from partner deployments, indirect revenue acceleration, and long-term GTM execution while maintaining AI safety standards. Strong-fit signals include partner-facing SA/SE/TAM experience, management of pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams, scaling partnerships with GSIs or cloud providers, indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, joint GTM motions, and enterprise AI deployment depth across LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
